positive_cases.prompt: 规划 MRI AI 辅助诊断相对当前流程的成本效用分析，明确 NHS 视角、比较策略、时域、QALY 和下游治疗。
required_checks: perspective horizon discounting and price year
QALY source and no double counting

positive_cases.prompt: 为低剂量 CT 筛查试验预设同期经济评价，收集资源利用、效用、重复检查和长期外推。
比较急诊 CT 自动分诊与常规流程，用 cost-consequence 同时列出成本、周转时间、漏诊升级、辐射重复和公平性。
估算地区医疗系统引入 PET/CT 新示踪剂三年的预算影响，包括符合条件人群、采用率、替代检查和年度成本。
审计一次性肺结节分流 decision tree：CT 风险分层后进入随访、PET/CT 或活检。
构建肿瘤影像随访的长期 Markov 模型，处理复发、重复扫描、治疗后状态和死亡。
解释这份 CUA 的单因素、结构情景和 PSA；作者只给 95% cost-effective 就说 95% 会获批。
required_checks: Monte Carlo error and run receipt

positive_cases.prompt: 在现有影像筛查模型上做 EVPI/EVPPI/EVSI，判断是继续研究检查准确性、效用还是采用率。
required_checks: VOI not ethics funding or feasibility approval

positive_cases.prompt: 按 CHEERS 2022 和 CHEERS-AI 审阅影像 AI 经济评价，并核对当地 HTA 方法是否仍适用。

boundary_cases.prompt: 给国自然标书列出扫描费、劳务费和服务器费预算。
boundary_cases.required_boundary: a project grant budget is not an economic evaluation or BIA

boundary_cases.prompt: 计算预测模型的 decision curve 和 threshold probability 下的 net benefit。
boundary_cases.required_boundary: decision-curve net benefit is not monetary net benefit or cost-effectiveness

boundary_cases.prompt: 审计这个阈值范围和 decision-curve net-benefit 指标是否适合支持临床效用主张。
boundary_cases.required_boundary: metric and threshold fitness is method evaluation; it is not economic value

boundary_cases.prompt: 估计 MRI 新序列对复发风险的因果效应并处理混杂。
决定当前指南下肺结节应该用哪个影像随访路径。
boundary_cases.required_boundary: current clinical pathway ownership remains external

boundary_cases.prompt: 根据这个 ICER 正式批准医保报销并给出收费编码。
根据 QALY 和费用决定这个患者能否做 PET/CT。
boundary_cases.required_boundary: population economic results do not authorize individual care

boundary_cases.prompt: 不要审模型，只把 health economics Discussion 改成英文。
boundary_cases.required_boundary: language editing is not economic-method ownership

invariants: Jurisdiction decision maker and live reference case precede HTA-specific advice
Population strategies comparator perspective horizon and outcome define the decision problem
A threshold is not transferred across jurisdictions as a universal constant
CEA CUA cost-consequence BIA and VOI remain distinct
A grant budget is not a budget impact analysis
Budget impact does not establish cost-effectiveness
A favourable ICER does not prove affordability
Diagnostic accuracy is an intermediate input rather than a QALY
Imaging benefit is linked through downstream actions and outcomes
Nondiagnostic equivocal false-positive false-negative repeat and incidental pathways remain visible
Time saved is not cash saved without an explicit capacity and valuation mechanism
Decision trees and state-transition models are selected for problem fit rather than prestige
Greater model complexity does not establish validity
Observed inputs external sources assumptions derivations scenarios inferences and recommendations remain distinct
Incremental results and dominance precede ICER interpretation
Negative ICERs are not interpreted without their cost-effect quadrant
Parameter structural methodological stochastic uncertainty and heterogeneity remain distinct
PSA preserves distributions correlations run identity and Monte Carlo error
Probability cost-effective is not probability clinically effective or approved
VOI requires a valid decision model and does not approve research
CHEERS is reporting guidance rather than a model-validity certificate
CHEERS-AI supplements rather than replaces CHEERS when applicable
Decision-curve net benefit is not monetary net benefit or an economic evaluation
HTA is multidisciplinary and economic evidence alone does not determine adoption
Coverage reimbursement procurement and individual patient decisions remain with authorised bodies
